# immich_server_storage (Data Source)

Retrieve the current storage utilization information from the Immich server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_server_storage" "storage" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `disk_available` (String) Available disk space (human readable format).
- `disk_available_raw` (Number) Available disk space in bytes.
- `disk_size` (String) Total disk size (human readable format).
- `disk_size_raw` (Number) Total disk size in bytes.
- `disk_usage_percentage` (Number) Disk usage percentage (0-100)
- `disk_use` (String) Used disk space (human readable format).
- `disk_use_raw` (Number) Used disk space in bytes.
